null_information_note: The historical H1 null permutes classifiable colour labels within species. A one-classifiable-photo species is invariant under this permutation and therefore contributes no within-species label-exchange information; two- and three-photo species contribute very limited within-species spatial information.

historical_h1.permitted_interpretation: No excess recurrent boundary concentration was detected in the globally broad but within-species sparse historical frame.
historical_h1.forbidden_overinterpretation: The result is not evidence that terrestrial geographic barriers never organize flower colour.

design_consequence: Global coverage and within-species information must be separated. The new atlas uses a metadata-wide census plus an adequately replicated inferential layer, with balanced repeated Monte Carlo species/photo inclusion rather than one monolithic all-photo analysis.
